cases.description: Default classDef styles and equivalent explicit class statement versus ::: syntax.
cases.source:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
classDef default fill:#fff1cc,stroke:#92400e,color:#1f2937,stroke-width:2px
classDef hot fill:#fee2e2,stroke:#b91c1c,color:#7f1d1d,stroke-width:4px
A[Default via classDef default]
B[Class statement]
C[Colon shorthand]
A --> B --> C
class B hot
C:::hot
```

cases.description: Repeated class statements assign multiple classes in both orders to expose pinned style concatenation and CSS last-declaration behavior.
cases.source:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
classDef cold fill:#dbeafe,stroke:#1d4ed8,color:#1e3a8a,stroke-width:2px
classDef hot fill:#ffedd5,stroke:#ea580c,color:#7c2d12,stroke-width:5px
A[Cold then hot]
B[Hot then cold]
A --> B
class A cold
class A hot
class B hot
class B cold
```

cases.description: Explicit node style overrides class declarations, and a repeated classDef appends a later set of declarations before rendering.
cases.source:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
classDef patch fill:#dbeafe,stroke:#1d4ed8,color:#1e3a8a,stroke-width:2px
A[Explicit style]
B[Redefined class]
C[Colon class]
A --> B --> C
class A patch
class B patch
C:::patch
style A fill:#fecaca,stroke:#b91c1c,color:#450a0a,stroke-width:6px
classDef patch fill:#dcfce7,stroke:#15803d,color:#14532d,stroke-width:4px
```
